Remarks

Datavalid compares the capture with the face on government record for the CPF and answers with a similarity. The application decides what counts as a match through MinSimilarity and AcceptedLiveness.

Fields

SectionName

Configuration section name this options class binds to.

public const string SectionName = "Datavalid"

Properties

AcceptedLiveness

Liveness values, as SERPRO reports them, that are accepted. Compared ignoring case. Empty (the default) leaves the liveness decision to SERPRO alone and only reports the value.

public IList<string> AcceptedLiveness { get; set; }

Property Value

IList<string>

Remarks

Set it from the values the contracted API version documents: once it holds any value, a capture whose liveness is missing or not listed is refused, whatever its similarity.

ConsumerKey

Consumer key of the contract. Server-side only.

ConsumerSecret

string

MinSimilarity

Lowest similarity (0.0 to 1.0) accepted as a match. Defaults to 0.9, where SERPRO's "high probability" band begins; below it a partial face can pass.

public double MinSimilarity { get; set; }

double
